input.body: We are writing to request a review of a deduction of $27.40 on order DD-48290, dated 2026-11-08, which was charged to us with the reason "missing item" for a Protein Bowl. The order ticket for DD-48290 lists a Fruit Bowl and a Green Smoothie, and does not list a Protein Bowl [DD-48290:ticket_omits_item]. The order was marked ready at 17:35 and was picked up by the courier at 17:39, four minutes later [DD-48290:pickup_handoff]. Based on the ticket, the item named in the claim was not part of the order as it was placed with us. We kindly ask that you review the deduction and reverse it. We are happy to provide any further information you need.
